payload.name: pc-check-tcp-port-list
payload.description: Pure-logic guard that validates a raw candidate TCP-port list before any network action. Reads the raw candidate from inputs.get('ports') so that missing, null, empty, scalar, boolean, non-list or out-of-range values are returned as an invalid result rather than raising. Accepts only a nonempty list of exact integers, each in 1..65535 inclusive; booleans are not integers and are rejected. Missing and null remain distinct: a missing key yields valid=false with ports=[]; an explicit null also yields valid=false with ports=[]. No imports, no I/O, no host calls and no UUIDs. Typed inputs are a target interface; the selected Monty runner must supply the inputs mapping and execute this body. Target input contract: inputs.get('ports') is the raw candidate. Target result contract: {valid: boolean, ports: original list if valid else []}. Missing typed-runner support is a prerequisite, not a runtime guarantee.
